description: This is a FastAPI Python application demonstrating background task handling, with endpoints for sending notifications and logging queries.

methods.name: write_log(message: str)
methods.description: Writes a message to a log file 'log.txt'.

methods.name: get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Determines if a query parameter is present, logs it asynchronously if so.

methods.name: send_notification( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Annotated[str, Depends(get_query)] )
methods.description: Endpoint to send a notification email, schedules log writing as a background task.

ctags.name: get_query
ctags.pattern: /^def get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str | None = None):$/

ctags.name: send_notification
ctags.signature: ( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Annotated[str, Depends(get_query)] )
